hardware: 8 x H800 (80 GB), one node, Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, 2 engines (TP2)

policy_only.note: the Miles router never reads the policy (ray/rollout/router_manager.py assigns it only on the SGLang-router branch), so the change is inert; measured within noise of the unrepaired arm.

caveats: one run per arm; the unrepaired and policy_only arms differ by 0.010, which bounds the run-to-run noise, so the threshold sits 0.088 below the passing arm and 0.129 above the strongest failing one
with only two engines a load-only choice is right about half the time by chance, which is why the unrepaired arm sits near 0.6 rather than near 0.5; the gap widens with more engines
the arms differ only in the router section of run_config.json; model, topology, training, rollout and workload are identical
